result.title: Auditable Clinical Support with Decision Agents
result.summary: Clinicians reviewing a diagnostic work-up will ask what was considered at each step and why the assessment changed. Agents powered by free text can reach physician-level diagnostic accuracy, but their written reasoning does not always reflect the factors that went into the decision. Here, we present Decision2Care, a decision agent that works up the acutely ill patient without producing any text. A decision model assigns a probability to each permitted EHR action, and fixed rules carry out the most probable one. We evaluated Decision2Care on the records of 546 emergency admissions across 12 diseases. Decision2Care reached a diagnostic accuracy of 86.5%, compared with 86.1% for the MIRA-v2 agent, and required a median of 2.2 s per work-up, compared with 92-100 s. Each work-up tracked which options Decision2Care was considering at each step. In 10 of the 12 diseases, the differential diagnosis changed most at the test on which the guideline bases the diagnosis. Where Decision2Care was most confident after a single work-up, all but four of its diagnoses were correct (98.5%). We traced each of these four errors back to a single imaging report. Three of them were corrected when that report was removed. The same kind of decision was used to select the treatments, and Decision2Care's drug orders were judged guideline-adherent more often than MIRA-v2's. In emergency patients, its prediction of death was comparable to that of three intensivists on the same cases. In five of the eight intensive care cohorts, it exceeded the best of the three 24-h severity scores within 2-6 h of records. Our results show that decision agents can carry out clinical work-ups while recording the options, probabilities, and execution rules behind each action for audit.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Decision2Care：不做自由文本生成的临床决策 agent，由决策模型为每个允许的 EHR 操作给出概率、固定规则执行最可能项，在 546 例急诊、12 种疾病上达到 86.5% 诊断准确率并显著更快，同时逐步记录所考虑的选项与执行规则以供审计。
AI.relevance_reason: 以「无文本的中间决策状态 + 概率化候选操作 + 可审计轨迹」替代书面推理，其显式记录被考虑选项、以及做何检查、何时停止的方式，可能为 LVR 的 latent 状态外部核查与证据获取/停止决策提供概念参照；但该工作属临床 EHR 应用而非视觉语言推理，迁移性需人工核查。
